enhancement_summary.title: Brittleness & Ambiguity Testing Framework - Integration Map

enhancement_outcomes: Created 3-tier testing framework with 85 automated tests (brittleness, ambiguity, DoR)
Established clarification workflow with CORTEX 6-aligned recommended answers (default YES)
Enforced halt-on-degradation blocking execution if design score < 95/100
All outputs in YAML/JSON format (no markdown plan files)
Automatic evidence bundle generation to tier1/evidence-bundles/

halt_conditions.execution_blocked_until: All clarifications resolved AND scores above thresholds

process: 2. Generate: Create clarification questions for failures
3. Present: Show question + recommended answer (default YES)
5. Recalculate: Re-run tests with clarifications applied

guarantees: Design score is calculable as weighted average (40% + 35% + 25%)
Execution halts automatically if score < 95 or DoR < 100%
All clarifications have recommended answers aligned with CORTEX 6 vision
All outputs in YAML/JSON format (structured data, no markdown)
Evidence bundles auto-generated for audit trail
Integration with EnhancedAuditLogger for full traceability
